data.one_liner: Widget that displays Qiblah direction using device sensors and location.
data.what_it_does: It reads the device’s compass and GPS to calculate the direction to Mecca and shows it as an arrow or text. The widget also reports GPS status and permission state.
use_when: You need to show Qiblah direction in an app
Your device has a compass sensor and GPS
You want a single widget that handles permissions and status
avoid_when: You need a custom map-based direction without the widget
strengths: Uses native sensors for accurate direction
Handles permission and GPS status internally
weaknesses: Does not work on iOS simulator
data.setup_notes: Add dependency, request location permission, add <FlutterQiblah> widget in UI. No build_runner needed.
